standard: Strict Continuous Chronological Partitioning (Causal Walk-Forward Standard)
policy: First 70% continuous calendar weeks (Weeks 1 to 210: Jan 2021 to Jan 2025) strictly for research, alpha discovery, and parameter calibration. Final 30% continuous calendar weeks (Weeks 211 to 300: Jan 2025 to Oct 2026) strictly quarantined for out-of-sample forward verification. Zero random week interleaving permitted.
